newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hai Sun Hup sees better 1997/1998 results.
newsitem.headline: Hai Sun Hup sees better 1997/1998 results.

text.p: Shipping-based Hai Sun Hup Group Ltd said on Tuesday it expects better results in the 1997/98 financial year.

The group, which also runs a string of hotels in Australia, said in a statement accompanying its financial results for the year ended March 31, 1997 the hotel industry outlook in Australia and New Zealand was expected to stay positive.
It said the group was benefitting from co-ordinated sales and marketing strategies under the "Stamford Hotels and Resorts" brand name.
Hai Sun Hup also expected the sale of residential apartments in Syndey, Australia to meet a favorable response.

In the 1997/98 financial year, Hai Sun Hup's net profit profit rose 21 percent to Singapore $36.79 million largely due to the hotel division, which contributed 56 percent of operating income before interest.
Hai Sun Hup said its shipowning, management and chartering division continued to perform satisfactorily under the weak and diffcult conditions in the shipping industry.
